competitions.name: Collegiate Unmanned Aircraft Systems Competition (CUASC) '26
competitions.description: Our FullWorks team designed, built, and flew a quadcopter UAS to complete autonomous mission tasks against other colleges and universities in June of 2026.

competitions.name: NASA MINDS Competition '24
competitions.description: Our club's team won first place at the 2024 NASA MINDS (MUREP Innovative New Designs for Space) competition, beating Cal Poly Pomona, Fresno State, and other four-year schools nationwide. The team built an RFID-based system that helps astronauts find lost tools and objects in under 10 seconds, earning a $3,000 prize and a VIP trip to Kennedy Space Center.

competitions.name: Collegiate Unmanned Aircraft Systems Competition (CUASC) '27
competitions.description: Our FullWorks team will iterate on the former MQ-611 UAS to complete autonomous mission tasks against other colleges and universities in June 2027.

competitions.name: CSU 3D-Printed Fixed-Wing Aircraft Competition (C-3DPAC) '27
competitions.description: Our team will design and 3D print a fixed-wing aircraft to compete against other colleges and universities at Cal State LA on May 29, 2027. Entries are judged on flight performance (eight seconds of powered propulsion followed by a glide) and on design innovation.

competitions.name: Design and Evaluation of a 3D-Printed Orthopedic Splint
competitions.description: Can a custom 3D-printed splint be made lighter and more breathable than a conventional splint while still providing useful structural stiffness? A student-led research project running through the fall semester, ending in a physical tri-fold research board, a tested prototype, and a dataset comparing printed and conventional splints.
